python3 -c "
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

# Per-seed
# seed=42: obs_only 19/100, argmin 12/100
t42 = [[19, 81], [12, 88]]
odds42, p42 = fisher_exact(t42, alternative='greater')
print(f'seed=42: obs_only=19%, argmin=12%, OR={odds42:.2f}, p={p42:.4f}')

# seed=43: obs_only 12/100, argmin 17/100
t43 = [[12, 88], [17, 83]]
odds43, p43 = fisher_exact(t43, alternative='greater')
print(f'seed=43: obs_only=12%, argmin=17%, OR={odds43:.2f}, p={p43:.4f}')

# Pooled: obs_only 31/200 vs argmin 29/200
tp = [[31, 169], [29, 171]]
oddsp, pp = fisher_exact(tp, alternative='greater')
print(f'Pooled: obs_only=31/200(15.5%), argmin=29/200(14.5%), OR={oddsp:.2f}, p={pp:.4f}')

# Two-sided pooled
oddsp2, pp2 = fisher_exact(tp, alternative='two-sided')
print(f'Pooled two-sided: OR={oddsp2:.2f}, p={pp2:.4f}')
"
